page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.4xlarge is an ARM64-based, compute-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a dedicated CPU allocation of one thread per core. This architecture eliminates hyperthreading overhead, providing predictable compute execution for multi-threaded applications.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It includes 950 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store volumes directly attached to the Nitro hypervisor. This local storage configuration supports applications requiring low-latency disk access, though users must manage the ephemeral nature of instance store data.

Network connectivity is rated at an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 Graviton architecture combined with local NVMe storage offers a high density of compute and fast local storage per resource unit, making it a viable alternative to x86-based instances for compatible workloads.

This hardware profile is designed for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from local scratch space or high-speed caching, such as distributed databases, log processing, media encoding, and containerized microservices optimized for ARM64.
